name: Darby IPP
subtitle: Isopropyl palmitate
description: For creams, lotions, sunscreens, makeup, pressed powders and lipsticks.
composition: A synthetic ester of isopropyl alcohol and palmitic acid (C₁₉H₃₈O₂), a saturated fatty acid commonly derived from plant oils. A clear, colorless, odorless oily liquid with a silky, non-greasy, fast-absorbing texture; insoluble in water and miscible with oils, mineral oil, silicones and alcohols. Emollient, spreading and penetration enhancer, fragrance solvent and binder.
